# SCOP function gateway

This page routes tasks to the relevant SCOP functions and tutorial chapters. For exact arguments and current upstream documentation, use the [SCOP reference index](https://mengxu98.github.io/scop/reference/).

| Task | Main functions | Tutorial |
|---|---|---|
| bundled data / conversion | `LoadScopDataset()`, `FetchH5()`, `h5ad_to_srt()`, `loom_to_srt()` | [inputs](input-formats.qmd) |
| cell QC | `RunCellQC()`, `db_scDblFinder()`, `RunDecontX()`, `RunDoubletCalling()` | [single sample](single-cell-case.qmd) |
| spot QC | `RunSpotQC()` | [spatial](spatial-case.qmd) |
| integration | `Harmony_integrate()`, `CCA_integrate()`, `RPCA_integrate()`, `scVI_integrate()` | [multi-sample](multi-sample.qmd) |
| dimension choice | `RunDimsEstimate()` | [single sample](single-cell-case.qmd) |
| cluster stability | `ClusterTreePlot()` | [single sample](single-cell-case.qmd) |
| markers / DEG | `FindMarkers()`, `FindAllMarkers()` | [single](single-cell-case.qmd), [advanced](advanced.qmd) |
| annotation | `RunCellTypist()`, `RunSingleR()`, `RunLabelTransfer()` | [annotation](annotation.qmd) |
| enrichment | `RunEnrichment()`, `RunGSEA()` | [advanced](advanced.qmd) |
| proportions | `RunPropeller()`, `RunProportionTest()` | [advanced](advanced.qmd) |
| trajectory | `RunPAGA()`, `RunCytoTRACE()` | [advanced](advanced.qmd) |
| communication | `RunCellChat()`, `RunSpatialCellChat()` | [advanced](advanced.qmd) |
| regulation / metabolism | `RunSCENIC()`, `RunMetabolism()` | [advanced](advanced.qmd) |
| malignancy / phenotype | `RunCNV()`, `RunScissor()` | [advanced](advanced.qmd) |
| spatial features / graph | `RunSpatialVariableFeatures()`, `RunSpatialNetwork()`, `RunSpatialNeighborhood()` | [spatial](spatial-case.qmd) |
| deconvolution / integration | `RunRCTD()`, `RunSpatialIntegration()` | [spatial](spatial-case.qmd) |

## Select an integration method

| Method | Prefer when | Important prerequisite |
|---|---|---|
| Harmony | shared cell states, efficient batch correction | meaningful batch field and preserved biology checks |
| CCA | shared correlated structure across datasets | adequate common features and overlap |
| RPCA | conservative anchor integration for larger related data | within-dataset PCA and shared populations |
| scVI | nonlinear latent model and sufficient data | working Python backend and explicit version lock |

## Verify an exported function locally

```r
"Harmony_integrate" %in% getNamespaceExports("scop")
args(scop::Harmony_integrate)
help("Harmony_integrate", package = "scop")
```

The published runtime contained 314 exports. If your installed version differs, treat the local help and version as authoritative and record the difference.
